title: Layout and Restore Encoding Polish
release_notes: Removes the Dashboard Settings button from the dashboard header.
Expands the dashboard layout so wide screens use more space.
Expands the visitor page layout while keeping it responsive on small screens.
Displays member directory place names in uppercase.
Improves SQL restore encoding so future restores preserve Ñ/ñ from UTF-8 or Windows-1252 backups.
